start.speaker: Flowey
start.text: Howdy! I'm FLOWEY. FLOWEY the FLOWER!

explain.speaker: Flowey
explain.text: You're new to the UNDERGROUND, aren'tcha? Someone ought to teach you how things work around here!

help.speaker: Flowey
help.text: See that door to the east? Go through it to explore the corridor. Be careful though... not everyone is friendly.

independent.speaker: Flowey
independent.text: Ha! You've got spirit, kid. Fine, go ahead. But don't say I didn't warn ya!
